title: SWEEP and the 1964 money funnel in Sekret Machines

tellings.quote: But it involves all this money from this huge underground being funneled, hundreds of billions being funneled about the time of 1964.

plain: Around 1964, hundreds of billions of dollars were funnelled through a huge hidden or "underground" system, in a story tied to something called SWEEP. A researcher named Jason Simosa sums this up for Michels from Sekret Machines, a book series by the author Tom DeLonge, without naming any other source. If true, it would point to a vast secret budget dating back to the 1960s.
